title: Soldier and Traveling
statementMd:
In the country there are $*n*$ cities and $*m*$ bidirectional roads between them. Each city has an army. Army of the $*i*$-th city consists of $*a*_{*i*}$ soldiers. Now soldiers roam. After roaming each soldier has to either stay in his city or to go to the one of neighboring cities by at **moving along at most one road**.

Check if is it possible that after roaming there will be exactly $*b*_{*i*}$ soldiers in the $*i*$-th city.

## Input

First line of input consists of two integers $*n*$ and $*m*$ ($1 ≤ *n* ≤ 100$, $0 ≤ *m* ≤ 200$).

Next line contains $*n*$ integers $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{*n*}$ ($0 ≤ *a*_{*i*} ≤ 100$).

Next line contains $*n*$ integers $*b*_{1}, *b*_{2}, ..., *b*_{*n*}$ ($0 ≤ *b*_{*i*} ≤ 100$).

Then $*m*$ lines follow, each of them consists of two integers $*p*$ and $*q*$ ($1 ≤ *p*, *q* ≤ *n*$, $*p* ≠ *q*$) denoting that there is an undirected road between cities $*p*$ and $*q*$.

It is guaranteed that there is at most one road between each pair of cities.

## Output

If the conditions can not be met output single word "`NO`".

Otherwise output word "`YES`" and then $*n*$ lines, each of them consisting of $*n*$ integers. Number in the $*i*$-th line in the $*j*$-th column should denote how many soldiers should road from city $*i*$ to city $*j*$ (if $*i* ≠ *j*$) or how many soldiers should stay in city $*i*$ (if $*i* = *j*$).

If there are several possible answers you may output any of them.
statementZhMd:
这个国家有 $*n*$ 座城市，以及连接它们的 $*m*$ 条双向道路。每座城市都有一支军队。第 $*i*$ 座城市的军队由 $*a*_{*i*}$ 名士兵组成。现在，士兵们开始移动。移动结束后，每名士兵必须留在原城市，或**沿着至多一条道路移动**到相邻城市。

请判断移动结束后，第 $*i*$ 座城市中是否可能恰好有 $*b*_{*i*}$ 名士兵。

## 输入格式

输入的第一行包含两个整数 $*n*$ 和 $*m*$（$1 ≤ *n* ≤ 100$, $0 ≤ *m* ≤ 200$）。

下一行包含 $*n*$ 个整数 $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{*n*}$（$0 ≤ *a*_{*i*} ≤ 100$）。

下一行包含 $*n*$ 个整数 $*b*_{1}, *b*_{2}, ..., *b*_{*n*}$（$0 ≤ *b*_{*i*} ≤ 100$）。

接下来有 $*m*$ 行，每行包含两个整数 $*p*$ 和 $*q*$（$1 ≤ *p*, *q* ≤ *n*$，$*p* ≠ *q*$），表示城市 $*p*$ 和城市 $*q*$ 之间有一条无向道路。

保证任意一对城市之间至多有一条道路。

## 输出格式

如果无法满足条件，输出一个单词 "`NO`"。

否则，输出单词 "`YES`"，然后输出 $*n*$ 行，每行包含 $*n*$ 个整数。第 $*i*$ 行第 $*j*$ 列的数应表示从城市 $*i*$ 前往城市 $*j*$ 的士兵数量（当 $*i* ≠ *j*$ 时），或者应表示留在城市 $*i*$ 的士兵数量（当 $*i* = *j*$ 时）。

如果有多种可行答案，输出任意一种即可。
